about: Criterion-8 exceptions, read by testkit/beta_readiness.py. One metric on one unpromised document, bounded, tied to the accepted sweep (by file name and SHA-256), the harness reading and the release it was decided for; each one an owner decision recorded in docs/beta-bar.md ('Exceptions') in the same commit. Out of bounds, or stale (another release, accepted sweep or reading), it blocks; once nothing needs it, it is reported as unused and deleted.

dy_p50.decided_by: the owner, by delegation to an independent decider (Fable 5.1) for this one question
dy_p50.conditions: a. like for like: the final product sweep against this accepted sweep in the same (wp29) reading; under another reading, rescore first, and record nothing if y37 then clears tolerance. b. y37 dy_p50 only, against this accepted sweep, for 0.3.0b1; every other y37 metric gated at full tolerance; no other document. c. ceiling 32.0pt; above it, blocking and a new decision. d. on the final renders: word_recall >= 0.347, common-word dy_p50 <= 23.5pt, within2pt not worse beyond gate tolerance (testkit/churn.py --check-y37). e. recorded in docs/beta-bar.md in the same commit. f. dies with this accepted sweep; not carried to 0.3.0b2 or GA. g. void if c or d is missed, y37 becomes promised, or a second document needs the same exception before the tag.
